processed.title: Investigating potential molecular mechanisms linking 6PPD-quinone exposure to Intervertebral Disc Degeneration: A network toxicology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation study.
relevance_evidence: NCBI：完整查询命中（ESummary 未提供摘要，待全文质量门禁复核）

figures.label: Fig 1
figures.caption: Two-dimensional and three-dimensional structures of 6PPD-quinone. (A) Two-dimensional chemical structure of 6PPD-quinone. (B) Three-dimensional molecular conformation of 6PPD-quinone.

figures.label: Fig 2
figures.caption: Venn diagram of 6PPD-Q and IVDD-related targets.

figures.label: Fig 3
figures.caption: Candidate targets were identified by PPI analysis. A total of 12 key targets were obtained by screening 59 cross targets by DC, BC and CC.

figures.label: Fig 4
figures.caption: GO enrichment analysis. Including biological processes, cellular components, and molecular functions.

figures.label: Fig 5
figures.caption: The top 20 KEGG enrichment analysis pathways.

figures.label: Fig 6
figures.caption: Target–pathway interaction network of core genes and enriched KEGG pathways.

figures.label: Fig 7
figures.caption: The heat map and molecular docking results of 6PPD-Q biological compounds and core targets. (A) Binding energy value of molecular docking. (B) 6PPD-Q -PTGS2 complex. (C) 6PPD-Q -MMP2 complex. (D) 6PPD-Q -SMAD3 complex. (E) 6PPD-Q -RELA complex. (F) 6PPD-Q -GSK3B complex.

figures.label: Fig 8
figures.caption: Molecular dynamics simulation analysis of the 6PPD-Q–RELA complex. (A) Root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) profiles of the protein, ligand, and protein–ligand complex during the 100-ns simulation. (B) Root-mean-square fluctuation (RMSF) of protein residues. (C) Solvent-accessible surface area (SASA) of the complex over the simulation trajectory. (D) Radius of gyration (Rg) and its components along the principal axes. (E) Number of hydrogen bonds formed between 6PPD-Q and RELA during the simulation. (F) Free-energy landscape of the 6PPD-Q–RELA complex constructed based on RMSD and Rg.
